OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the stored and returned value is those 10 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

          properties:

              format: int32
              minimum: 0

            - pets

          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer

## Summary

I implemented optional owner `email` support so that, when present, it must be a syntactically valid address, is stored/returned lower-cased, and is rejected with 400 when invalid.

Changes made:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `email` property to the `OwnerFields` schema with `format: email`. Because the generator runs with `performBeanValidation=true`, this emits `@Email` on the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`, so an invalid address (e.g. `not-an-email`) is rejected as a 400 via the existing Bean Validation → `ExceptionControllerAdvice` path. It's not in `required`, so a missing email is accepted.

2. **`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`** — Added an `email` column (`@Column`, `@Email`) with getter/setter. MapStruct auto-maps it between the DTO and entity by name.

3. **`src/main/java/.../rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Added a `normalizeEmail` helper (lower-cases via `Locale.ROOT`, passes through `null`) and applied it in both `addOwner` and `updateOwner`, mirroring the existing telephone-normalization pattern.

4. **Schema/data SQL** — Added the `email` column to all four `schema.sql` files (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres). The tests run on the `hsqldb` profile with `ddl-auto=none`, so the column had to exist in `schema.sql`. I also gave the positional `owners` seed inserts in the hsqldb and mysql `data.sql` files explicit column lists (`(id, first_name, last_name, address, city, telephone)`) so they remain valid now that the table has an extra column (h2 and postgres already used column lists).
